purpose: Further-compressed shared P7-5.1 background-only style prompt. Scene prompts supply place, time, and camera separately.
common_contract: Empty edge-to-edge illustrated watercolor background; thin charcoal lines, transparent wet-on-wet watercolor, pigment pooling, granulation, cool shadows, medium-chroma color. No frame, text, logos, people, animals, vehicles, neon, photorealism, hatching, or screentone.
fixed_checks: edge-to-edge background without an outer frame or dark border
sparse thin charcoal contour and structure lines
transparent watercolor layers with wet-on-wet blooms, pigment pooling, granulation, and translucent edges
separate readable lit planes, cool shadows, and reflected-light accents
natural medium-chroma pigment without neon, opaque airbrush, photorealistic, screentone, dense hatching, or thick comic outlines
no readable signs, logos, people, animals, or vehicles
assembly_rule: Append this common_contract to exactly one scene prompt; scene prompts may change only location, time, camera, and scene-specific palette constraints.
